hp_model: Continuous numeric internal HP; visual stages do not quantize HP or damage.
fraction: Clamp current_hp / max_hp to [0, 1]; max_hp must be positive.
boss_bar: Named continuous health bar fixed at top center of screen, independent of ordinary enemy bar visibility

hit_feedback.status: Integration specification, not implemented by this artwork delivery
hit_feedback.trigger: Every successful damage event, even when the stage does not change
hit_feedback.behavior: Brief pale warm sprite flash plus local impact particles; preserve current damage row. Restart on each hit.
hit_feedback.flushfiend: Use same-row hit recoil frame briefly; do not reset to healthy artwork.
hit_feedback.widow: Keep current wingbeat frame and damaged feather/halo silhouette during flash.
hit_feedback.rapid_fire: Ensure flash ends before the next normal Tony shot; do not require crossing a threshold.

boss_hud.requirement_status: Named top-of-screen boss bar approved; dimensions and animation timings are initial tuning
boss_hud.implementation_status: Reusable HUD and headless preview implemented; no playable boss encounter; visual review pending
boss_hud.layout: Reserve a top HUD band; keep player HUD and telegraphed arena hazards clear; respect viewport safe margins.
boss_hud.visible_during: Entire active boss encounter, including closed/invulnerable phases
boss_hud.fill: Clamp current_hp / max_hp to [0, 1], draining right to left; no artificial slow drain or refill between phases.
boss_hud.style: Heavy industrial frame, dark empty track, green/yellow/red health fill; readable boss name and visible accumulated empty space.
boss_hud.numbers: Exact HP and damage remain development-only by default
boss_hud.death: Reach empty immediately at zero HP; retain name and empty bar for one second, then fade out.
boss_hud.reset: Hide on leaving encounter; reset fill and trail from boss HP on retry.

fill_colors.source: Clamped actual current_hp / max_hp, independent of trailing damage fill and attack phases
fill_colors.transition: Switch immediately at thresholds; no flashing
fill_colors.zero_hp: No colored fill; retain empty track during death hold
fill_colors.accessibility: Remaining bar length always communicates health independently of color
